posts.author: DrFreeman
posts.body:
RPG Maker is primarily designed for turn based JRPGs. But sometimes it can be fun making an engine do innovative actions. First person, side view, isometric, so why not action RPG? I've compiled a list of some of the best action battle system plugins. I've mainly been looking for MV/MZ since it has on-going support.
